meta.name: methylation-aggregation
meta.description: Build comprehensive DNA methylation maps by aggregating WGBS (Whole Genome Bisulfite Sequencing) data across multiple ENCODE experiments, donors, and labs. Use when the user wants to answer "where is DNA methylated/unmethylated in my tissue?" by combining per-CpG methylation data into tissue-level methylation profiles. Handles coverage filtering, identifies hypomethylated regions (HMRs) and partially methylated domains (PMDs), and manages cross-lab variation.

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个样本中整合DNA甲基化数据并识别差异区域。
copy.tagline_en: Aggregate WGBS data to build tissue-level DNA methylation maps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to integrate DNA methylation data across multiple samples and identify differential regions.

howto.what: 该技能会整合多个ENCODE实验的WGBS数据，生成组织级别的DNA甲基化图谱，包括每个CpG位点的平均甲基化水平，并识别低甲基化区域（HMRs）和部分甲基化区域（PMDs）。
howto.when: 当用户询问特定组织（如肝脏、大脑）中DNA甲基化或未甲基化的位置，或需要汇总多个供体的甲基化数据时触发。

howto.what_en: This skill aggregates WGBS data from multiple ENCODE experiments to build a tissue-level DNA methylation map, including per-CpG average methylation levels and identification of hypomethylated regions (HMRs) and partially methylated domains (PMDs).
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about DNA methylation or unmethylation in a specific tissue (e.g., liver, brain) or needs to aggregate methylation data across multiple donors.
